files.description: Quiz results (80 rows, one per student in seat order, no other columns): quiz_a and quiz_b (points 0-10, whole numbers, many equal values; about 9% and 6% of cells empty for absent students).

task_text: Read both quiz columns as whole numbers that allow empty cells. Rank the students in quiz_a from the top: rank 1 is the highest score, and equal scores all get the best rank of their group (for example 1, 1, 3). Absent students (empty cell) get no rank. `result` should be a Series with one rank per student in file order.
intended_computation: Minimum-method descending ranks of the 73 non-empty quiz_a scores; missing for the 7 absent students; 80 values in file order.

acceptable_variants.notes: missing values in any null representation; ranks may be whole numbers or decimals.

predicted_direction.reason: On 2.x rank() on the nullable column also ranked the absent students (at the bottom); on 3.x they stay missing as the task asks.

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 by pkg:TASKS_M2 for catalogue row N06; naive.py shows the invited idiom, reference.py is the version-robust reference.
